facts.fact: Neela has not turned tonight: she skipped resin so she could sit in the open west window as a woman. She holds Ammu's thumb of resin in a pouch, kept for ch31. Devan still holds the river pebble out of habit and sets it in his palm.
facts.why: needed because the beat has her open the shutters at dusk but ch31 stages the deliberate turning.

facts.fact: Devan says that on the night Neela put her fingers at the base of his skull (the marma point) and counted three breaths, he was awake, holding his sleeping breath too even, and that this was when he knew he could trust her. The scene is told undated, between her arrival and the storm.
facts.why: needed because the beat names this as when he decided to trust her; the exact chapter of the original event is not given in the supplied material.

facts.fact: Devan tells Neela he barred the shutters on the second dusk, pulled the sentry, kennelled the hounds and stopped Janu's stories so that no one else could become her witness, having decided before lifting the bar never to use what he had seen.
facts.why: needed because the beat answers his refusal in chapter 3.

facts.fact: The guild tooth is a real leopard canine from the Resin House store, sewn into Neela's waistband; Devan pricks his thumb on it and a welt rises on her thumb.
facts.why: needed to show the wound-share in a small, light beat and to give the tooth a physical origin.

facts.fact: Neela tells Devan the full terms of her twelfth contract and Chathu's threat, but offers no account of her earlier eleven contracts and mentions no lookout job; she does not know which fort the lookout job was.
facts.why: needed to keep the chapter inside the bible's secret map, where the lookout revelation is held for book 2 chapter 16.
